findings.finding: Selected source inspection covers main snapshot 784d1fff. A later branch lookup at 22:35:37 UTC returned de7d7067; that later source tree was not reviewed. The cu130 index captured at 22:25:07 advertises 0c258492. No wheel was downloaded.

Merged fixes remove cross-round reused random draws and undo stop-trimmed token accounting; distinguish resumable input sessions from ordinary SSE output. DSpark also gets a separate draft-buffer request cap rather than duplicate target-slot charging.

New quantized shared draft head is MRV2 EAGLE/MTP only and excludes Gemma4 MTP and DSpark/DFlash. MegaMoE NVFP4 row has no model caller in that merge and only SwiGLU; it does not establish Kimi NVFP4/SiTU integration.

GLM sparse-MLA metadata update is gated to DCP=1, PCP=1 and no HiSparse. Shared recurrent align-gather fusion has stride and row-index correctness requirements; an MI355X kernel microbenchmark is not a B300 end-to-end gain.

Merged cuBLAS initialization is before init_snapshot, contrary to stale PR-description placement. GPU weight preloading and experimental TP1 process snapshots have different state/lifetime boundaries. GLM Flash 4+4 NIXL recipe requires matching DS/HND layouts and MTP5 on both roles.
